description: One public X (Twitter) post by URL or ID from the JSON behind X's official embed widget: text, language, date, like and reply counts, edit status, reply-to, links, hashtags, mentions, photos and video (poster, duration, MP4 variants), quoted post, and the author (name, handle, blue check, label). Retweet, view and bookmark counts are not in this source. Timelines and search need X's paid API. Deleted or protected posts return 404. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_x_com_profiles when you need Public X profiles for up to 10 usernames via the free; social_labx_com when you need Listings of one LabX seller from the seller's public. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
